verses.en: L. M

verses.ar: غُلِبَتِ الرُّوۡمُۙ‏
verses.en: The Roman Empire has been defeated

verses.ar: فِيۡ٘ اَدۡنَي الۡاَرۡضِ وَهُمۡ مِّنۭۡ بَعۡدِ غَلَبِهِمۡ سَيَغۡلِبُوۡنَۙ‏
verses.en: In a land close by; but they, (even) after (this) defeat of theirs, will soon be victorious

verses.ar: فِيۡ بِضۡعِ سِنِيۡنَ ࣢ؕ لِلّٰهِ الۡاَمۡرُ مِنۡ قَبۡلُ وَمِنۭۡ بَعۡدُؕ وَيَوۡمَئِذٍ يَّفۡرَحُ الۡمُؤۡمِنُوۡنَۙ‏
verses.en: Within a few years. With Allah is the Decision, in the past and in the Future: on that Day shall the Believers rejoice

verses.ar: بِنَصۡرِ اللّٰهِؕ يَنۡصُرُ مَنۡ يَّشَآءُؕ وَهُوَ الۡعَزِيۡزُ الرَّحِيۡمُۙ‏
verses.en: With the help of Allah. He helps whom He will, and He is exalted in might, most merciful

verses.ar: وَعۡدَ اللّٰهِؕ لَا يُخۡلِفُ اللّٰهُ وَعۡدَهٗ وَلٰكِنَّ اَكۡثَرَ النَّاسِ لَا يَعۡلَمُوۡنَ
verses.en: (It is) the promise of Allah. Never does Allah depart from His promise: but most men understand not

verses.ar: يَعۡلَمُوۡنَ ظَاهِرًا مِّنَ الۡحَيٰوةِ الدُّنۡيَاۚۖ وَهُمۡ عَنِ الۡاٰخِرَةِ هُمۡ غٰفِلُوۡنَ
verses.en: They know but the outer (things) in the life of this world: but of the End of things they are heedless

verses.ar: اَوَلَمۡ يَتَفَكَّرُوۡا فِيۡ٘ اَنۡفُسِهِمۡࣞ مَا خَلَقَ اللّٰهُ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضَ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا٘ اِلَّا بِالۡحَقِّ وَاَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّيؕ وَاِنَّ كَثِيۡرًا مِّنَ النَّاسِ بِلِقَآئِ رَبِّهِمۡ لَكٰفِرُوۡنَ
verses.en: Do they not reflect in their own minds? Not but for just ends and for a term appointed, did Allah create the heavens and the earth, and all between them: yet are there truly many among men who deny the meeting with their Lord (at the Resurrection)

verses.ar: اَوَلَمۡ يَسِيۡرُوۡا فِي الۡاَرۡضِ فَيَنۡظُرُوۡا كَيۡفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ الَّذِيۡنَ مِنۡ قَبۡلِهِمۡؕ كَانُوۡ٘ا اَشَدَّ مِنۡهُمۡ قُوَّةً وَّاَثَارُوا الۡاَرۡضَ وَعَمَرُوۡهَا٘ اَكۡثَرَ مِمَّا عَمَرُوۡهَا وَجَآءَتۡهُمۡ رُسُلُهُمۡ بِالۡبَيِّنٰتِؕ فَمَا كَانَ اللّٰهُ لِيَظۡلِمَهُمۡ وَلٰكِنۡ كَانُوۡ٘ا اَنۡفُسَهُمۡ يَظۡلِمُوۡنَؕ‏
verses.en: Do they not travel through the earth, and see what was the end of those before them? They were superior to them in strength: they tilled the soil and populated it in greater numbers than these have done: there came to them their messengers with Clear (Signs). (Which they rejected, to their own destruction): It was not Allah Who wronged them, but they wronged their own souls

verses.ar: ثُمَّ كَانَ عَاقِبَةَ الَّذِيۡنَ اَسَآءُوا السُّوۡٓاٰ٘ي اَنۡ كَذَّبُوۡا بِاٰيٰتِ اللّٰهِ وَكَانُوۡا بِهَا يَسۡتَهۡزِءُوۡنَࣖ‏
verses.en: In the long run evil in the extreme will be the End of those who do evil; for that they rejected the Signs of Allah, and held them up to ridicule

verses.ar: اَللّٰهُ يَبۡدَؤُا الۡخَلۡقَ ثُمَّ يُعِيۡدُهٗ ثُمَّ اِلَيۡهِ تُرۡجَعُوۡنَ
verses.en: It is Allah Who begins (the process of) creation; then repeats it; then shall ye be brought back to Him

verses.ar: وَيَوۡمَ تَقُوۡمُ السَّاعَةُ يُبۡلِسُ الۡمُجۡرِمُوۡنَ
verses.en: On the Day that the Hour will be established, the guilty will be struck dumb with despair

verses.ar: وَلَمۡ يَكُنۡ لَّهُمۡ مِّنۡ شُرَكَآئِهِمۡ شُفَعٰٓؤُا وَكَانُوۡا بِشُرَكَآئِهِمۡ كٰفِرِيۡنَ
verses.en: No intercessor will they have among their "Partners" and they will (themselves) reject their "Partners

verses.ar: وَيَوۡمَ تَقُوۡمُ السَّاعَةُ يَوۡمَئِذٍ يَّتَفَرَّقُوۡنَ
verses.en: On the Day that the Hour will be established,- that Day shall (all men) be sorted out

verses.ar: فَاَمَّا الَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ فَهُمۡ فِيۡ رَوۡضَةٍ يُّحۡبَرُوۡنَ
verses.en: Then those who have believed and worked righteous deeds, shall be made happy in a Mead of Delight

verses.ar: وَاَمَّا الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡا وَكَذَّبُوۡا بِاٰيٰتِنَا وَلِقَآئِ الۡاٰخِرَةِ فَاُولٰٓئِكَ فِي الۡعَذَابِ مُحۡضَرُوۡنَ
verses.en: And those who have rejected Faith and falsely denied our Signs and the meeting of the Hereafter,- such shall be brought forth to Punishment

verses.ar: فَسُبۡحٰنَ اللّٰهِ حِيۡنَ تُمۡسُوۡنَ وَحِيۡنَ تُصۡبِحُوۡنَ
verses.en: So (give) glory to Allah, when ye reach eventide and when ye rise in the morning

verses.ar: وَلَهُ الۡحَمۡدُ فِي السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضِ وَعَشِيًّا وَّحِيۡنَ تُظۡهِرُوۡنَ
verses.en: Yea, to Him be praise, in the heavens and on earth; and in the late afternoon and when the day begins to decline

verses.ar: يُخۡرِجُ الۡحَيَّ مِنَ الۡمَيِّتِ وَيُخۡرِجُ الۡمَيِّتَ مِنَ الۡحَيِّ وَيُحۡيِ الۡاَرۡضَ بَعۡدَ مَوۡتِهَاؕ وَكَذٰلِكَ تُخۡرَجُوۡنَࣖ‏
verses.en: It is He Who brings out the living from the dead, and brings out the dead from the living, and Who gives life to the earth after it is dead: and thus shall ye be brought out (from the dead)

verses.ar: وَمِنۡ اٰيٰتِهٖ٘ اَنۡ خَلَقَكُمۡ مِّنۡ تُرَابٍ ثُمَّ اِذَا٘ اَنۡتُمۡ بَشَرٌ تَنۡتَشِرُوۡنَ
verses.en: Among His Signs in this, that He created you from dust; and then,- behold, ye are men scattered (far and wide)

verses.ar: وَمِنۡ اٰيٰتِهٖ٘ اَنۡ خَلَقَ لَكُمۡ مِّنۡ اَنۡفُسِكُمۡ اَزۡوَاجًا لِّتَسۡكُنُوۡ٘ا اِلَيۡهَا وَجَعَلَ بَيۡنَكُمۡ مَّوَدَّةً وَّرَحۡمَةًؕ اِنَّ فِيۡ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰيٰتٍ لِّقَوۡمٍ يَّتَفَكَّرُوۡنَ
verses.en: And among His Signs is this, that He created for you mates from among yourselves, that ye may dwell in tranquillity with them, and He has put love and mercy between your (hearts): verily in that are Signs for those who reflect

verses.ar: وَمِنۡ اٰيٰتِهٖ خَلۡقُ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضِ وَاخۡتِلَافُ اَلۡسِنَتِكُمۡ وَاَلۡوَانِكُمۡؕ اِنَّ فِيۡ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰيٰتٍ لِّلۡعٰلِمِيۡنَ
verses.en: And among His Signs is the creation of the heavens and the earth, and the variations in your languages and your colours: verily in that are Signs for those who know

verses.ar: وَمِنۡ اٰيٰتِهٖ مَنَامُكُمۡ بِالَّيۡلِ وَالنَّهَارِ وَابۡتِغَآؤُكُمۡ مِّنۡ فَضۡلِهٖؕ اِنَّ فِيۡ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰيٰتٍ لِّقَوۡمٍ يَّسۡمَعُوۡنَ
verses.en: And among His Signs is the sleep that ye take by night and by day, and the quest that ye (make for livelihood) out of His Bounty: verily in that are signs for those who hearken

verses.ar: وَمِنۡ اٰيٰتِهٖ يُرِيۡكُمُ الۡبَرۡقَ خَوۡفًا وَّطَمَعًا وَّيُنَزِّلُ مِنَ السَّمَآءِ مَآءً فَيُحۡيٖ بِهِ الۡاَرۡضَ بَعۡدَ مَوۡتِهَاؕ اِنَّ فِيۡ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰيٰتٍ لِّقَوۡمٍ يَّعۡقِلُوۡنَ
verses.en: And among His Signs, He shows you the lightning, by way both of fear and of hope, and He sends down rain from the sky and with it gives life to the earth after it is dead: verily in that are Signs for those who are wise

verses.ar: وَمِنۡ اٰيٰتِهٖ٘ اَنۡ تَقُوۡمَ السَّمَآءُ وَالۡاَرۡضُ بِاَمۡرِهٖؕ ثُمَّ اِذَا دَعَاكُمۡ دَعۡوَةًࣗۖ مِّنَ الۡاَرۡضِ اِذَا٘ اَنۡتُمۡ تَخۡرُجُوۡنَ
verses.en: And among His Signs is this, that heaven and earth stand by His Command: then when He calls you, by a single call, from the earth, behold, ye (straightway) come forth

verses.ar: وَلَهٗ مَنۡ فِي السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضِؕ كُلٌّ لَّهٗ قٰنِتُوۡنَ
verses.en: To Him belongs every being that is in the heavens and on earth: all are devoutly obedient to Him

verses.ar: وَهُوَ الَّذِيۡ يَبۡدَؤُا الۡخَلۡقَ ثُمَّ يُعِيۡدُهٗ وَهُوَ اَهۡوَنُ عَلَيۡهِؕ وَلَهُ الۡمَثَلُ الۡاَعۡلٰي فِي السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضِۚ وَهُوَ الۡعَزِيۡزُ الۡحَكِيۡمُࣖ‏
verses.en: It is He Who begins (the process of) creation; then repeats it; and for Him it is most easy. To Him belongs the loftiest similitude (we can think of) in the heavens and the earth: for He is Exalted in Might, full of wisdom

verses.ar: ضَرَبَ لَكُمۡ مَّثَلًا مِّنۡ اَنۡفُسِكُمۡؕ هَلۡ لَّكُمۡ مِّنۡ مَّا مَلَكَتۡ اَيۡمَانُكُمۡ مِّنۡ شُرَكَآءَ فِيۡ مَا رَزَقۡنٰكُمۡ فَاَنۡتُمۡ فِيۡهِ سَوَآءٌ تَخَافُوۡنَهُمۡ كَخِيۡفَتِكُمۡ اَنۡفُسَكُمۡؕ كَذٰلِكَ نُفَصِّلُ الۡاٰيٰتِ لِقَوۡمٍ يَّعۡقِلُوۡنَ
verses.en: He does propound to you a similitude from your own (experience): do ye have partners among those whom your right hands possess, to share as equals in the wealth We have bestowed on you? Do ye fear them as ye fear each other? Thus do we explain the Signs in detail to a people that understand

verses.ar: بَلِ اتَّبَعَ الَّذِيۡنَ ظَلَمُوۡ٘ا اَهۡوَآءَهُمۡ بِغَيۡرِ عِلۡمٍۚ فَمَنۡ يَّهۡدِيۡ مَنۡ اَضَلَّ اللّٰهُؕ وَمَا لَهُمۡ مِّنۡ نّٰصِرِيۡنَ
verses.en: Nay, the wrong-doers (merely) follow their own lusts, being devoid of knowledge. But who will guide those whom Allah leaves astray? To them there will be no helpers

verses.ar: فَاَقِمۡ وَجۡهَكَ لِلدِّيۡنِ حَنِيۡفًاؕ فِطۡرَتَ اللّٰهِ الَّتِيۡ فَطَرَ النَّاسَ عَلَيۡهَاؕ لَا تَبۡدِيۡلَ لِخَلۡقِ اللّٰهِؕ ذٰلِكَ الدِّيۡنُ الۡقَيِّمُࣗۙ وَلٰكِنَّ اَكۡثَرَ النَّاسِ لَا يَعۡلَمُوۡنَࣗۙ‏
verses.en: So set thou thy face steadily and truly to the Faith: (establish) Allah's handiwork according to the pattern on which He has made mankind: no change (let there be) in the work (wrought) by Allah: that is the standard Religion: but most among mankind understand not

verses.ar: مُنِيۡبِيۡنَ اِلَيۡهِ وَاتَّقُوۡهُ وَاَقِيۡمُوا الصَّلٰوةَ وَلَا تَكُوۡنُوۡا مِنَ الۡمُشۡرِكِيۡنَۙ‏
verses.en: Turn ye back in repentance to Him, and fear Him: establish regular prayers, and be not ye among those who join gods with Allah

verses.ar: مِنَ الَّذِيۡنَ فَرَّقُوۡا دِيۡنَهُمۡ وَكَانُوۡا شِيَعًاؕ كُلُّ حِزۡبٍۭ بِمَا لَدَيۡهِمۡ فَرِحُوۡنَ
verses.en: Those who split up their Religion, and become (mere) Sects,- each party rejoicing in that which is with itself

verses.ar: وَاِذَا مَسَّ النَّاسَ ضُرٌّ دَعَوۡا رَبَّهُمۡ مُّنِيۡبِيۡنَ اِلَيۡهِ ثُمَّ اِذَا٘ اَذَاقَهُمۡ مِّنۡهُ رَحۡمَةً اِذَا فَرِيۡقٌ مِّنۡهُمۡ بِرَبِّهِمۡ يُشۡرِكُوۡنَۙ‏
verses.en: When trouble touches men, they cry to their Lord, turning back to Him in repentance: but when He gives them a taste of Mercy as from Himself, behold, some of them pay part-worship to other god's besides their Lord

verses.ar: لِيَكۡفُرُوۡا بِمَا٘ اٰتَيۡنٰهُمۡؕ فَتَمَتَّعُوۡاࣟ فَسَوۡفَ تَعۡلَمُوۡنَ
verses.en: (As if) to show their ingratitude for the (favours) We have bestowed on them! Then enjoy (your brief day); but soon will ye know (your folly)

verses.ar: اَمۡ اَنۡزَلۡنَا عَلَيۡهِمۡ سُلۡطٰنًا فَهُوَ يَتَكَلَّمُ بِمَا كَانُوۡا بِهٖ يُشۡرِكُوۡنَ
verses.en: Or have We sent down authority to them, which points out to them the things to which they pay part-worship

verses.ar: وَاِذَا٘ اَذَقۡنَا النَّاسَ رَحۡمَةً فَرِحُوۡا بِهَاؕ وَاِنۡ تُصِبۡهُمۡ سَيِّئَةٌۭ بِمَا قَدَّمَتۡ اَيۡدِيۡهِمۡ اِذَا هُمۡ يَقۡنَطُوۡنَ
verses.en: When We give men a taste of Mercy, they exult thereat: and when some evil afflicts them because of what their (own) hands have sent forth, behold, they are in despair

verses.ar: اَوَلَمۡ يَرَوۡا اَنَّ اللّٰهَ يَبۡسُطُ الرِّزۡقَ لِمَنۡ يَّشَآءُ وَيَقۡدِرُؕ اِنَّ فِيۡ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰيٰتٍ لِّقَوۡمٍ يُّؤۡمِنُوۡنَ
verses.en: See they not that Allah enlarges the provision and restricts it, to whomsoever He pleases? Verily in that are Signs for those who believe

verses.ar: فَاٰتِ ذَا الۡقُرۡبٰي حَقَّهٗ وَالۡمِسۡكِيۡنَ وَابۡنَ السَّبِيۡلِؕ ذٰلِكَ خَيۡرٌ لِّلَّذِيۡنَ يُرِيۡدُوۡنَ وَجۡهَ اللّٰهِؗ وَاُولٰٓئِكَ هُمُ الۡمُفۡلِحُوۡنَ
verses.en: So give what is due to kindred, the needy, and the wayfarer. That is best for those who seek the Countenance, of Allah, and it is they who will prosper

verses.ar: وَمَا٘ اٰتَيۡتُمۡ مِّنۡ رِّبًا لِّيَرۡبُوَا۠ فِيۡ٘ اَمۡوَالِ النَّاسِ فَلَا يَرۡبُوۡا عِنۡدَ اللّٰهِۚ وَمَا٘ اٰتَيۡتُمۡ مِّنۡ زَكٰوةٍ تُرِيۡدُوۡنَ وَجۡهَ اللّٰهِ فَاُولٰٓئِكَ هُمُ الۡمُضۡعِفُوۡنَ
verses.en: That which ye lay out for increase through the property of (other) people, will have no increase with Allah: but that which ye lay out for charity, seeking the Countenance of Allah, (will increase): it is these who will get a recompense multiplied

verses.ar: اَللّٰهُ الَّذِيۡ خَلَقَكُمۡ ثُمَّ رَزَقَكُمۡ ثُمَّ يُمِيۡتُكُمۡ ثُمَّ يُحۡيِيۡكُمۡؕ هَلۡ مِنۡ شُرَكَآئِكُمۡ مَّنۡ يَّفۡعَلُ مِنۡ ذٰلِكُمۡ مِّنۡ شَيۡءٍؕ سُبۡحٰنَهٗ وَتَعٰلٰي عَمَّا يُشۡرِكُوۡنَࣖ‏
verses.en: It is Allah Who has created you: further, He has provided for your sustenance; then He will cause you to die; and again He will give you life. Are there any of your (false) "Partners" who can do any single one of these things? Glory to Him! and high is He above the partners they attribute (to him)

verses.ar: ظَهَرَ الۡفَسَادُ فِي الۡبَرِّ وَالۡبَحۡرِ بِمَا كَسَبَتۡ اَيۡدِي النَّاسِ لِيُذِيۡقَهُمۡ بَعۡضَ الَّذِيۡ عَمِلُوۡا لَعَلَّهُمۡ يَرۡجِعُوۡنَ
verses.en: Mischief has appeared on land and sea because of (the meed) that the hands of men have earned, that (Allah) may give them a taste of some of their deeds: in order that they may turn back (from Evil)

verses.ar: قُلۡ سِيۡرُوۡا فِي الۡاَرۡضِ فَانۡظُرُوۡا كَيۡفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ الَّذِيۡنَ مِنۡ قَبۡلُؕ كَانَ اَكۡثَرُهُمۡ مُّشۡرِكِيۡنَ
verses.en: Say: "Travel through the earth and see what was the end of those before (you): Most of them worshipped others besides Allah

verses.ar: فَاَقِمۡ وَجۡهَكَ لِلدِّيۡنِ الۡقَيِّمِ مِنۡ قَبۡلِ اَنۡ يَّاۡتِيَ يَوۡمٌ لَّا مَرَدَّ لَهٗ مِنَ اللّٰهِ يَوۡمَئِذٍ يَّصَّدَّعُوۡنَ
verses.en: But set thou thy face to the right Religion before there come from Allah the Day which there is no chance of averting: on that Day shall men be divided (in two)

verses.ar: مَنۡ كَفَرَ فَعَلَيۡهِ كُفۡرُهٗۚ وَمَنۡ عَمِلَ صَالِحًا فَلِاَنۡفُسِهِمۡ يَمۡهَدُوۡنَۙ‏
verses.en: Those who reject Faith will suffer from that rejection: and those who work righteousness will spread their couch (of repose) for themselves (in heaven)

verses.ar: لِيَجۡزِيَ الَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ مِنۡ فَضۡلِهٖؕ اِنَّهٗ لَا يُحِبُّ الۡكٰفِرِيۡنَ
verses.en: That He may reward those who believe and work righteous deeds, out of his Bounty. For He loves not those who reject Faith

verses.ar: وَمِنۡ اٰيٰتِهٖ٘ اَنۡ يُّرۡسِلَ الرِّيٰحَ مُبَشِّرٰتٍ وَّلِيُذِيۡقَكُمۡ مِّنۡ رَّحۡمَتِهٖ وَلِتَجۡرِيَ الۡفُلۡكُ بِاَمۡرِهٖ وَلِتَبۡتَغُوۡا مِنۡ فَضۡلِهٖ وَلَعَلَّكُمۡ تَشۡكُرُوۡنَ
verses.en: Among His Signs is this, that He sends the Winds, as heralds of Glad Tidings, giving you a taste of His (Grace and) Mercy,- that the ships may sail (majestically) by His Command and that ye may seek of His Bounty: in order that ye may be grateful

verses.ar: وَلَقَدۡ اَرۡسَلۡنَا مِنۡ قَبۡلِكَ رُسُلًا اِلٰي قَوۡمِهِمۡ فَجَآءُوۡهُمۡ بِالۡبَيِّنٰتِ فَانۡتَقَمۡنَا مِنَ الَّذِيۡنَ اَجۡرَمُوۡاؕ وَكَانَ حَقًّا عَلَيۡنَا نَصۡرُ الۡمُؤۡمِنِيۡنَ
verses.en: We did indeed send, before thee, messengers to their (respective) peoples, and they came to them with Clear Signs: then, to those who transgressed, We meted out Retribution: and it was due from Us to aid those who believed

verses.ar: اَللّٰهُ الَّذِيۡ يُرۡسِلُ الرِّيٰحَ فَتُثِيۡرُ سَحَابًا فَيَبۡسُطُهٗ فِي السَّمَآءِ كَيۡفَ يَشَآءُ وَيَجۡعَلُهٗ كِسَفًا فَتَرَي الۡوَدۡقَ يَخۡرُجُ مِنۡ خِلٰلِهٖۚ فَاِذَا٘ اَصَابَ بِهٖ مَنۡ يَّشَآءُ مِنۡ عِبَادِهٖ٘ اِذَا هُمۡ يَسۡتَبۡشِرُوۡنَ
verses.en: It is Allah Who sends the Winds, and they raise the Clouds: then does He spread them in the sky as He wills, and break them into fragments, until thou seest rain-drops issue from the midst thereof: then when He has made them reach such of his servants as He wills behold, they do rejoice

verses.ar: وَاِنۡ كَانُوۡا مِنۡ قَبۡلِ اَنۡ يُّنَزَّلَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ مِّنۡ قَبۡلِهٖ لَمُبۡلِسِيۡنَ
verses.en: Even though, before they received (the rain) - just before this - they were dumb with despair

verses.ar: فَانۡظُرۡ اِلٰ٘ي اٰثٰرِ رَحۡمَتِ اللّٰهِ كَيۡفَ يُحۡيِ الۡاَرۡضَ بَعۡدَ مَوۡتِهَاؕ اِنَّ ذٰلِكَ لَمُحۡيِ الۡمَوۡتٰيۚ وَهُوَ عَلٰي كُلِّ شَيۡءٍ قَدِيۡرٌ
verses.en: Then contemplate (O man!) the memorials of Allah's Mercy!- how He gives life to the earth after its death: verily the same will give life to the men who are dead: for He has power over all things

verses.ar: وَلَئِنۡ اَرۡسَلۡنَا رِيۡحًا فَرَاَوۡهُ مُصۡفَرًّا لَّظَلُّوۡا مِنۭۡ بَعۡدِهٖ يَكۡفُرُوۡنَ
verses.en: And if We (but) send a Wind from which they see (their tilth) turn yellow,- behold, they become, thereafter, Ungrateful (Unbelievers)

verses.ar: فَاِنَّكَ لَا تُسۡمِعُ الۡمَوۡتٰي وَلَا تُسۡمِعُ الصُّمَّ الدُّعَآءَ اِذَا وَلَّوۡا مُدۡبِرِيۡنَ
verses.en: So verily thou canst not make the dead to hear, nor canst thou make the deaf to hear the call, when they show their backs and turn away

verses.ar: وَمَا٘ اَنۡتَ بِهٰدِ الۡعُمۡيِ عَنۡ ضَلٰلَتِهِمۡؕ اِنۡ تُسۡمِعُ اِلَّا مَنۡ يُّؤۡمِنُ بِاٰيٰتِنَا فَهُمۡ مُّسۡلِمُوۡنَࣖ‏
verses.en: Nor canst thou lead back the blind from their straying: only those wilt thou make to hear, who believe in Our signs and submit (their wills in Islam)

verses.ar: اَللّٰهُ الَّذِيۡ خَلَقَكُمۡ مِّنۡ ضُۙعۡفٍ ثُمَّ جَعَلَ مِنۭۡ بَعۡدِ ضُۙعۡفٍ قُوَّةً ثُمَّ جَعَلَ مِنۭۡ بَعۡدِ قُوَّةٍ ضُۙعۡفًا وَّشَيۡبَةًؕ يَخۡلُقُ مَا يَشَآءُۚ وَهُوَ الۡعَلِيۡمُ الۡقَدِيۡرُ
verses.en: It is Allah Who created you in a state of (helpless) weakness, then gave (you) strength after weakness, then, after strength, gave (you weakness and a hoary head: He creates as He wills, and it is He Who has all knowledge and power)

verses.ar: وَيَوۡمَ تَقُوۡمُ السَّاعَةُ يُقۡسِمُ الۡمُجۡرِمُوۡنَ ࣢ۙ مَا لَبِثُوۡا غَيۡرَ سَاعَةٍؕ كَذٰلِكَ كَانُوۡا يُؤۡفَكُوۡنَ
verses.en: On the Day that the Hour (of Reckoning) will be established, the transgressors will swear that they tarried not but an hour: thus were they used to being deluded

verses.ar: وَقَالَ الَّذِيۡنَ اُوۡتُوا الۡعِلۡمَ وَالۡاِيۡمَانَ لَقَدۡ لَبِثۡتُمۡ فِيۡ كِتٰبِ اللّٰهِ اِلٰي يَوۡمِ الۡبَعۡثِؗ فَهٰذَا يَوۡمُ الۡبَعۡثِ وَلٰكِنَّكُمۡ كُنۡتُمۡ لَا تَعۡلَمُوۡنَ
verses.en: But those endued with knowledge and faith will say: "Indeed ye did tarry, within Allah's Decree, to the Day of Resurrection, and this is the Day of Resurrection: but ye - ye were not aware

verses.ar: فَيَوۡمَئِذٍ لَّا يَنۡفَعُ الَّذِيۡنَ ظَلَمُوۡا مَعۡذِرَتُهُمۡ وَلَا هُمۡ يُسۡتَعۡتَبُوۡنَ
verses.en: So on that Day no excuse of theirs will avail the transgressors, nor will they be invited (then) to seek grace (by repentance)

verses.ar: وَلَقَدۡ ضَرَبۡنَا لِلنَّاسِ فِيۡ هٰذَا الۡقُرۡاٰنِ مِنۡ كُلِّ مَثَلٍؕ وَلَئِنۡ جِئۡتَهُمۡ بِاٰيَةٍ لَّيَقُوۡلَنَّ الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡ٘ا اِنۡ اَنۡتُمۡ اِلَّا مُبۡطِلُوۡنَ
verses.en: verily We have propounded for men, in this Qur'an every kind of Parable: But if thou bring to them any Sign, the Unbelievers are sure to say, "Ye do nothing but talk vanities

verses.ar: كَذٰلِكَ يَطۡبَعُ اللّٰهُ عَلٰي قُلُوۡبِ الَّذِيۡنَ لَا يَعۡلَمُوۡنَ
verses.en: Thus does Allah seal up the hearts of those who understand not

verses.ar: فَاصۡبِرۡ اِنَّ وَعۡدَ اللّٰهِ حَقٌّ وَّلَا يَسۡتَخِفَّنَّكَ الَّذِيۡنَ لَا يُوۡقِنُوۡنَࣖ‏
verses.en: So patiently persevere: for verily the promise of Allah is true: nor let those shake thy firmness, who have (themselves) no certainty of faith
